entities.summary: Valtteri Puustinen is a Finnish professional ice hockey player who is a winger for the Colorado Eagles of the American Hockey League (AHL) while under contract to the Colorado Avalanche of the National Hockey League (NHL). He made his NHL debut in 2022.
